source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Use Ireasoning MIB browser professional:
1. Enable SNMP v3 agent settings from WEB UI. (Refer to WebGUI spec/user guide).
2. Enable the corresponding user account SNMPv3 settings at WEB UI.
3. Open Ireasoning MIB browser, load the MIB files.
4. Setup the settings of MIB browser to access BMC according to the WEB UI SNMPv3 settings.
5. Left-click on the $target and expand subtree.
6. Right-Click on the node and use "Get Next" or "Get Subtree" to get all the values of the $target.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
Use NetSNMP to check.
1. Enable SNMP v3 agent settings from WEB UI. (Refer to WebGUI spec/user guide).
2. Enable the corresponding user account SNMPv3 settings at WEB UI.
3. Put the mib files into the netsnmp search path.
http://www.net-snmp.org/docs/FAQ.html#Where_should_I_put_my_MIB_files_
4. Use NetSNMP "get type" of command(s) to retrieve the values of the $target from BMC.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: snmpwalk (net-snmp), BMC SNMP agent must be enabled + community configured
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- SNMP "monitor_disks" monitoring reads specific BMC MIB data via the SNMP agent; from a 2nd management host run `snmpwalk -v2c -c ${SNMP_COMMUNITY:?operator must set SNMP community (v2c) or v3 creds} "$BMC_IP" .1.3.6.1.4.1.8072.2.3.2.1.2 | grep -i disks (or walk the vendor MIB subtree once the SNMP community/v3 creds + MIB are configured). Enable + point SNMP agent first.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL snmpwalk output for the disk/FRU OID subtree so the user confirms the monitor_disks SNMP data is correct.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: SNMP queries need a management host + enabled/configured SNMP agent on the BMC (community/v3 + firewall); enabling SNMP is a config change, and some BMC SNMP sets expose credentials - use read-only community.

historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED / CHANGED; correctly identifies missing scope, object mapping and baseline, but treats obtainable Project storage-model inputs as permanent ambiguity.

original_test_intent: Retrieve the Project-defined storage inventory and health objects over SNMPv3, bind each returned entry to the intended physical drive, enclosure slot, FRU or logical volume layer, and compare identity and state with an authoritative topology baseline.
original_method: An engineer enables an SNMPv3 account in WebUI and uses IReasoning MIB Browser Get Next/Get Subtree on undefined `$target`; Criteria switch to Net-SNMP and neither source defines whether `disks` means FRUs, physical drives, controller logical volumes or host block devices.
manual_activity: An engineer must define the tested storage layer, approve the topology/status contract and configure the BMC SNMPv3 account. The agent can then collect bounded inventory/status objects and reconcile them with an independent controller, Redfish or host view.
required_inputs: in-scope physical drive, enclosure/FRU, controller or logical-volume layer
vendor MIB module/version and exact object OIDs, indexes, types and status enums
expected populated/absent device topology and acceptable health states
identifier redaction policy for serial/WWN/asset data
least-privilege SNMPv3 profile and manager ACL
approved client equivalence and cleanup policy
safety_requirements: Keep execution read-only: never issue SNMP SET, identify/blink, reset, initialize, clear, remove, rebuild, sanitize, format or write against storage.
Do not infer a physical drive from a FRU record, a logical volume from a disk label or a host device from an unstable `/dev` name.
Do not use v2c, the generic `.1.3.6.1.4.1.8072...` example or grep-only/empty output as storage evidence.
Protect SNMPv3 secrets and redact unnecessary serial, WWN and asset identifiers while preserving stable correlation tokens.
Stop on an unknown mapping, write-capable object, unexpected state transition, degraded array/drive or BMC/controller instability; do not auto-remediate or retry.
Restore temporary SNMPv3 configuration and verify storage topology/state remained unchanged.
agent_execution_scope: After engineer setup, query only approved vendor-MIB storage inventory/health objects via bounded SNMPv3 GET/GETNEXT/WALK and retain typed index/status evidence.
Correlate each entry with the approved slot/controller/device/FRU/logical-volume baseline and independent read-only telemetry, reporting missing, extra, duplicate, stale or mismatched states.
Do not operate WebUI, perform any storage action, derive identity from device number alone, claim IReasoning coverage when only Net-SNMP ran or issue a DUT verdict.
engineer_actions: Define the exact storage layer and approve the OID/index/status and topology baseline.
Configure and restore least-privilege SNMPv3, approve identifier handling and IReasoning versus Net-SNMP equivalence.
Investigate degraded or mismatched inventory through approved storage procedures and issue PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The command uses the wrong security mode and an unrelated demonstration OID; grep cannot distinguish FRU presence, physical-drive health, logical-volume state or host disk identity.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use exact vendor-MIB SNMPv3 objects for one approved storage layer, preserve complete typed rows and indexes, redact sensitive identifiers and correlate with a read-only authoritative topology source.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: IReasoning, SNMPv3 WebUI/account setup, undefined `$target`, Net-SNMP Criteria and 10/5-minute values remain preserved source evidence.

modernized_recommendation.status: PROJECT STORAGE OBJECT AND TOPOLOGY CONTRACT REQUIRED
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Choose and name the storage layer, map every MIB row/index to stable enclosure-slot/controller/device or logical-volume identity, retrieve its identity and state with bounded SNMPv3 and compare with controller/Redfish/host topology without any corrective action.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The identified chassis, storage controller/backplane/BMC firmware and matching vendor MIB.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record chassis, backplane, controller firmware, BMC firmware, MIB and client versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor storage inventory/health MIB and status-enum documentation plus Project topology.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds storage-layer definition, stable identity correlation, state semantics, privacy handling and a strict no-write boundary without replacing the original client checkpoint.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: FRU presence cannot stand in for media health, physical-drive data cannot prove logical-volume health and host enumeration alone cannot prove BMC inventory correctness.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Layer, objects, indexes/enums, topology baseline, independent source, redaction and client decision.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: BMC inventory may lag controller state and hot-plug changes; timestamps and authoritative correlation are required before judging mismatch.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC may select physical drives, FRUs or logical volumes and may approve Net-SNMP instead of IReasoning, but must state the chosen layer, omitted layers, original/actual tool, object-level equivalence and any unverified GUI-client coverage. Results cannot be generalized to omitted layers.
expected_evidence: approved storage-layer scope, topology baseline and identity-correlation map
redacted SNMPv3 WebUI/account/ACL configuration and cleanup artifacts
vendor MIB identity with numeric OID/type/index/status-enum mapping
complete bounded typed SNMPv3 storage rows with stable redacted correlation tokens
timestamped comparison with independent controller/Redfish/host inventory and health
proof no storage state changed, tool-equivalence statement, errors/health logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The word `disks` does not identify a storage layer, Procedure requires IReasoning/SNMPv3 while Criteria changes to Net-SNMP, `$target` is undefined, and DeepSeek changes to v2c while labeling an unrelated generic subtree `disk/FRU`. The read-only inventory/health purpose remains recoverable through Project scope inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The Project must choose the intended storage layer and provide the exact object/topology/status baseline; these are execution-readiness inputs for a clear read-only inventory purpose. Once supplied, bounded collection is automatable after manual setup, so permanent BLOCKED is not justified.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains hybrid execution but rejects the v2c/generic OID, disk/FRU conflation and grep evidence, adding stable layer-specific identity and no-write controls.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Changes BLOCKED to REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION because the storage model and baseline are normal Project inputs under ED-36, while preserving a hard stop until they exist.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Independently confirms its classification while correcting its contradictory comparison wording and strengthening cross-layer non-equivalence.

review_improvement: Separates FRU presence, physical-drive health, controller logical state and host enumeration, and requires stable cross-source identity before any conclusion while explicitly prohibiting remedial storage actions.
independent_technical_reasoning: Storage entities at different layers can share labels yet represent different failure domains. A generic walk or word filter cannot establish which one was measured, and an unsafe follow-on action must never be inferred. The required layer, object and topology contract can be supplied by Project SPEC, so the review is readiness-gated rather than permanently blocked.
